prompt:
You are an experienced sommelier comparing two wine recommenders. A
customer with no wine knowledge made this request:

"I need a nice white wine that tastes like honey and butter, but something light. Price doesn't matter since it's a present, and I'd love to try a new bottle."

List A:
Wine 1: Pinot Grigio, US, $10. Tasting note: "Drink this dryish wine with almost anything that calls for a light-bodied, crisp white, and don't worry about it. It has savory citrus flavors, with a pleasant hint of vanilla honey."
Wine 2: Fiano, US, $26. Tasting note: "This is an interesting, dry white wine from an unusual grape variety. It's more savory than fruity, as the aromas resemble white and black pepper, while flavors are subtle and figgy. The texture is quite rich and the finish lingers nicely. It's very full-bodied for a white, and definitely worth a try."
Wine 3: Verdelho, US, $15. Tasting note: "With mouthwatering crispness and a pleasantly bitter, minerally tone, this fine, dry white wine is versatile at the table. It has savory flavors of citrus fruits, honeysuckle flowers and white pepper."
Wine 4: Pinot Grigio, US, $10. Tasting note: "This is a sweet, softly simple wine whose apricot, citrus and peach flavors will satisfy those looking for a decent everyday white wine."
Wine 5: Grenache Blanc, US, $30. Tasting note: "A delicious and interesting white wine, made from a variety more usually used for blending purposes. It's honey-rich but dry, similar in structure to an oaky Chardonnay, with tropical fruit and vanilla flavors that have a pleasant touch of bitterness."

List B:
Wine 1: Pinot Grigio, US, $10. Tasting note: "Drink this dryish wine with almost anything that calls for a light-bodied, crisp white, and don't worry about it. It has savory citrus flavors, with a pleasant hint of vanilla honey."
Wine 2: Pinot Grigio, US, $13. Tasting note: "This is a light, steely white with more honeysuckle and floral characteristics than fruit. It's light in alcohol and texture, and especially good for the wine drinker looking for something subtle."
Wine 3: White Blend, Italy, $10. Tasting note: "Described as medium-sweet on the label, this light white wine offers tones of peach nectar, honey and white flower. It is a simple and one dimensional wine with a subtle touch of sweetness on the close. Pair it with salty appetizers."
Wine 4: Gewürztraminer, France, $33. Tasting note: "Light gold in color, this rose scented wine has a touch of honey and some richness. There is dryness as well, bringing out walnuts and an edge of bitterness. This is wine to drink now."
Wine 5: Sherry, US, $25. Tasting note: "Intensely sweet and super-drinkable, this Sherry-style wine has a light, creamy texture with potent flavors of white chocolate, raspberry honey, tangerine zest, vanilla crème brûlée and dusty spices. It's a gorgeous wine, a perfect way to end a great dinner with dainty little dessert pastries."

Which list answers the request better as a whole: relevance to every wish,
variety where the request leaves room, and fit for any occasion? If they
are equally good, say tie. Think briefly, then answer with JSON only:
{"reason": "<two sentences at most>", "better": "A" | "B" | "tie"}
